title: Elizondo confirms Hastings' UFOs and nukes reporting

tellings.quote: he's right he is legit he has his observations and and his conclusions are spoton I couldn't talk about it at the time when I was in the government uh but we everything he was reporting we saw yep it was absolutely correct

In 2021, Luis “Lue” Elizondo, the former director of a previously-secret UFO project at the Pentagon—the Advanced Aerospace Threat Identification Program (AATIP)—confirmed in a podcast that his group had utilized the book as a resource when conducting its own research into UFO incursions at nuclear weapon sites. Said Elizondo, “There was a lot of information we didn’t have access to that, it turned out, Robert Hastings did … We were able to validate and substantiate exactly what he was saying.”

plain: Luis Elizondo, who once ran AATIP, a small Pentagon office that studied unexplained aerial reports, tells Michels that the journalist Robert Hastings's reporting on UFOs at nuclear weapons sites is correct: "everything he was reporting we saw," he says, adding that he could not say so while in government. If true, it would mean the Pentagon's own UFO office had matching data. Hastings's 2024 article quotes Elizondo on a 2021 podcast saying AATIP used Hastings's book UFOs and Nukes as a resource and "we were able to validate and substantiate exactly what he was saying."
